required_environment.name: COSYVOICE_DIR
required_environment.purpose: Pinned CosyVoice checkout with the exact companion patch set applied.

required_environment.name: PRETRAINED_DIR
required_environment.purpose: Pinned local Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B runtime model directory.

required_environment.name: BASE_LLM_CHECKPOINT
required_environment.purpose: Pinned base llm.pt used to initialize LoRA training.

required_environment.name: QWEN_PRETRAIN_DIR
required_environment.purpose: Pinned CosyVoice-BlankEN tokenizer and configuration directory.

required_environment.name: TRAIN_CONFIG
required_environment.purpose: CosyVoice3 HyperPyYAML training configuration.

required_environment.name: MAX_EPOCH
required_environment.purpose: Explicit positive train_conf.max_epoch override applied after loading the full model config.

required_environment.name: LEARNING_RATE
required_environment.purpose: Explicit positive LoRA optimizer learning rate.

required_environment.name: TRAIN_DATA_LIST
required_environment.purpose: Prepared CosyVoice parquet training data list.

required_environment.name: CV_DATA_LIST
required_environment.purpose: Prepared CosyVoice parquet cross-validation data list.

required_environment.name: PREPARED_TRAIN_ROOT
required_environment.purpose: Root containing the training data list and every referenced prepared artifact.

required_environment.name: PREPARED_VALIDATION_ROOT
required_environment.purpose: Root containing the validation data list and every referenced prepared artifact.

required_environment.name: DATASET_LINEAGE
required_environment.purpose: Content-addressed receipt binding audited splits to both prepared data trees.

required_environment.name: RAW_TRAIN_JSONL
required_environment.purpose: Raw training split used for grouped corpus audit.

required_environment.name: RAW_VALIDATION_JSONL
required_environment.purpose: Raw validation split used for grouped corpus audit.

required_environment.name: RAW_TEST_JSONL
required_environment.purpose: Raw test split used for grouped corpus audit.

required_environment.name: REFERENCE_AUDIO
required_environment.purpose: Authorized reference-speaker audio for reload and held-out synthesis.

required_environment.name: REFERENCE_TEXT
required_environment.purpose: Transcript matching the authorized reference audio.

required_environment.name: SELECTED_ADAPTER_NAME
required_environment.purpose: Single safe LoRA checkpoint directory selected for reload.

required_environment.name: GENERATION_PLAN
required_environment.purpose: Frozen Instavar Voice generation plan containing this candidate.

required_environment.name: CANDIDATE_ID
required_environment.purpose: Candidate identifier present in the frozen generation plan.

required_environment.name: TRAIN_ENGINE
required_environment.purpose: Explicit torch_ddp or deepspeed training engine.
